activities.body: Engagement letter signed by Priya Anand (Chief Operating Officer). Scope: one agent serving one Larkspur channel, operated by MultiAgency. Reporting: an operating report is due by close of business on the first day of each month, beginning 2026-03-01. No other deliverables are named.
Operating report for the first period delivered to Priya Anand and Del Moreau. Covered availability, message volume and two configuration changes.
Second monthly operating report delivered on the due date.
Third monthly operating report delivered three days after the due date. Del Moreau acknowledged receipt and raised no issue with the delay.

Call with Priya Anand. She said Larkspur wants a second channel added for the warehouse team and that this is agreed on their side: 'go ahead and stand it up, we'll square the paperwork.' No amendment to the engagement letter has been received.
The second channel is live for the warehouse team. Standing it up followed the 14 July call; the signed engagement letter still describes one channel.
